ah:
interj. An exclamation, expressive of surprise, pity, complaint,
entreaty, contempt, threatening, delight, triumph, etc., according to
aha:
interj. An exclamation expressing, by different intonations,
triumph, mixed with derision or irony, or simple surprise.
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>口語感嘆詞，表恍然大悟或發現</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>由 ah＋ha 組合而成的感嘆詞，沒有可拆解的詞根</dd></dl>
ahead:
a. 領先的, 預先的, 向前的
adv. 領先, 預先, 向前, 勝於, 在前面, 在將來

s. having the leading position or higher score in a contest
r. at or in the front

語感
中性，日常用字
詞根詞綴
a- ＋ head，皆屬古英語，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆
常見搭配
go ahead；ahead of time／schedule；plan ahead；look ahead
近義詞
forward：向前方的方向
in front：靠在前方的位置
注意事項
ahead of 後面接名詞，是「在…前面、領先」；Go ahead 是「請便」的客氣回應
ahem: n the utterance of a sound similar to clearing the throat; intended to get attention, express hesitancy, fill a pause, hide embarrassment, warn a friend, etc.
ahh: abbr. [生化]芳基烴羥化酶（Aryl Hydrocarbon Hydroxylase）
ahi: <dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">夏威夷語 ʽahi（黃鰭金槍魚）</dd></dl>
ahimsa: n. a Buddhist and Hindu and especially Jainist doctrine holding that all forms of life are sacred and urging the avoidance of violence
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">梵語 ahiṁs（不害），源自 a-（2a-）＋hiṁsā（傷害），源自 hiṁsati（他傷害）；同源於梵語 hinvati（他投擲、驅使）——另見 goad</dd></dl>
ahistorical: a. (與)歷史無關的, (無)歷史記載的
a. unconcerned with or unrelated to history or to historical development or to tradition
ahmad: n. 阿哈默德（穆罕默德在《古蘭經》中的名稱）
ahold:
n. 抓, 握
adv. 迎風航駛
adv. Near the wind; as, to lay a ship ahold.
ahoy: interj. A term used in hailing; as, "Ship ahoy."
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>航海用語，帶有老派海員的趣味</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>Ship ahoy!；Ahoy there!</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">用於船上打招呼或引起注意；一般場合使用帶有玩笑意味</dd></dl>
